consensus_summary: The reviewer cards contain no per-seat editorial recommendations, so recommendation consensus is conservatively unresolved and the Schema 6 package uses SPLIT without inferring individual votes. At finding level, no card explicitly disputes another card; EIC-W3 and R2-W2 independently corroborate the correction-companion defect below the CONSENSUS-3 threshold, while every other non-DA sub-claim is a single-reviewer finding and DA findings are counted separately. Because revision-roadmap/1.0 has no corroborated-finding enum, SINGLE-VERIFIER is used conservatively for all below-consensus items; source_refs and corroborating_sources preserve exact source multiplicity. The roadmap is a non-ranking reviewer proposal only and supplies no write authority, bibliography-mutation authority, scientific execution, venue/readiness finding, or Route credit.
